quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within 30 feet upon the approach to any official traffic-control signal located at the side of a highway.

activation.condition: Vehicle stops, stands or parks within 30 feet upon the approach to an official traffic-control signal located at the side of a highway.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park in the specified approach zone unless a source exception applies.

exceptions.trigger: Necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
exceptions.effect: Exception when necessity is established from original traffic evidence.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original traffic evidence for independent review.
exceptions.source_clause: except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic

exceptions.effect: Exception when another law actually governs the activity.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain source authority for independent review.

exceptions.effect: Exception when an actual police direction applies.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original officer direction evidence for review.
exceptions.source_clause: the directions of a police officer

exceptions.effect: Exception when an official device direction applies.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original device authority and indication evidence for review.

timing.description: Observe the complete interval of stop, stand or park on the signal approach.

parameter_refs.name: requested_front_gap_ft
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: 25, 30 or 35 feet requested; actual footprint independently measured

parameter_refs.name: activity_mode
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: stop, stand or park attempt; original classification independently reviewed

parameter_refs.name: exception_context_request
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: none, necessary conflict, other law, police direction or official device direction

parameter_refs.name: observed_signal_approach_state
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original footprint, velocity, signal location and source context or unknown
